summary: An excellent opportunity for investors to acquire this two-bedroom mid-terraced property, situated in a convenient residential location in Stockton-on-Tees. The property benefits from front and rear gardens and is currently occupied by a tenant paying £600 per calendar month, providing an immediate rental income stream for an investor.
description:
The accommodation offers an attractive proposition for both experienced landlords and those looking to take their first step into the buy-to-let market. With a tenant already in situ, the property provides the potential for a straightforward investment with rental income being generated from completion, subject to the existing tenancy arrangements. The property is conveniently located within easy reach of Stockton town centre, where a wide range of shops, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants and everyday amenities can be found. Stockton railway station is also within easy walking distance, providing convenient rail connections for commuters and those travelling further afield. The surrounding area also benefits from local bus services, providing access to Stockton and the wider Teesside area. There are a number of schools and other useful amenities close by, making the location appealing to a wide range of potential tenants. The property's position also provides good access to the wider road network, making it convenient for travelling throughout Stockton-on-Tees and surrounding areas. Early viewing is highly recommended to appreciate the location, accommodation and investment potential this property has to offer.

ENTRANCE HALL

Accessed via a UPVC framed double-glazed entrance door, the entrance hall features a UPVC framed double-glazed window providing natural light. Stairs rise to the first floor, with access to the accommodation beyond.

LOUNGE The lounge features a UPVC framed double-glazed window providing plenty of natural light. There is a modern wall-mounted feature fire surround with inset and hearth, complemented by a radiator.

KITCHEN / BREAKFAST ROOM The kitchen breakfast room is fitted with a range of base and wall-mounted units, complemented by laminate work surfaces and an inset sink unit with drainer and mixer tap. There is tiling to the splashback and work surface areas, together with an integrated oven, hob and extractor. The kitchen also benefits from plumbing for an automatic washing machine and dishwasher, along with an integrated fridge and freezer. A breakfast bar provides a useful dining area. There is a uPVC framed double-glazed window, a uPVC framed double-glazed door providing access to the exterior, and a radiator.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING The first floor landing provides access to all rooms and benefits from a useful built-in storage cupboard, providing additional practical storage space.

BEDROOM ONE Bedroom One is a spacious double bedroom offering ample room for a range of bedroom furniture. The room benefits from a UPVC framed double-glazed window providing natural light, together with a radiator.

BEDROOM TWO Bedroom Two benefits from a UPVC framed double-glazed window providing natural light, together with a radiator.

FAMILY BATHROOM The family bathroom is fitted with a white suite comprising a panel bath, wash hand basin and WC. The walls and floor are tiled, with a radiator and UPVC framed double-glazed window providing natural light and ventilation.

EXTERNALLY To the front of the property is a wall-enclosed garden with gated access. To the rear is a further good-sized, fence-enclosed garden with gated access, together with a driveway providing useful off-road parking.
